item.p: Grammar grammars/value_template inherits grammars/xpath: (the XPATH root) with field body value_template_body (STRING_TEMPLATE), parts value_template_fixed_part (STRING_TEMPLATE_FIXED_PART) and the XPath enclosed_expression. Its own src/scanner.c wraps the shared query scanner and appends two tokens after the shared list (which is untouched): the fixed part (5.6: {{, }}; a backquote and "(:" are text) and a zero-width start token, so the body exists for a zero-length template.

Entry sxml_xslt_build_value_template_ast in a new src/xslt_value_template_internal.h (the packet named no header; the module's own). A parser part () with three node types and a describe_payload hook that decodes the template's own fixed parts; a fixed part of an XPath string template inside a variable part keeps the XPath decoder (told apart by the body's last child, the variable part being walked). The AST equals that of `...` but for spans.

Errors: the grammar decides acceptance (). After XPST0003 a lexical scan (fixed parts, string literals, comments, nested brackets and string templates; nesting up to 64 in one word) finds XTSE0370 (an unescaped } in a fixed part) or XTSE0350 (a { never closed), with the location of that bracket; otherwise XPST0003 stays.

Effective value is the string template's lowering (): each variable part atomized and joined with spaces. 5.7.2 (simple content) also merges adjacent text nodes and drops zero-length ones first, so {text{'a'}, text{'b'}} gives "a b", not "ab": left to 4.6, which lowers sequence constructors.

Every grammar joins the link line of sxml (grammars/CMakeLists.txt, a call deferred to the end of the root directory), so 3.2 and 4.4 need no edit of the root CMakeLists.txt for xquery and xslt_pattern (an explicit entry there is harmless).

Check: tools/qt4-parse-check.py --spec XT40 --value-templates (scope of ; attribute value templates from the element syntax summaries, literal result elements and shadow attributes; text value templates under expand-text, xsl:note merged away): 12,244 value templates, 12,232 accepted, 0 false rejects, 11 "either" (the 5 of error-0350a/b, error-0370a and cvt-013 rejected); 1 uses optional record fields d?, dropped from the XPath 4.0 draft. Every valid one also builds through the C entry.
